name: King of the Hill
summary: King of the Hill is a stream native auto battler where the audience is the general. Two fantasy factions fight on their own over a single hill while Twitch chat decides the reinforcements, elite units, meteor nukes and bosses that crash onto the field. Viewers type short command words to charge shared power meters; when a meter fills, a slot machine wheel spins and fires one power live on stream. A tug of war bar tracks the battle, and the moment one faction is shoved to its win end a champion is crowned and a fresh fight begins, running 24/7 with no end. There is nothing to install and nothing to grind: anyone watching can join by typing in chat. Players pick a faction to root for and push the war by hyping commands together.
